source_duplicate_audit.finding: No existing exception-message normalization found on any of the 22 current source branch heads. Core page aggregation and result-error catches, ScanWorker future-result catch, and both shard producer catches all retain str(exception) directly. PR18 changes rendering of truthy provider errors only and cannot classify empty error strings. PR3 retry budgets/classification and PR19 shape validation do not normalize these producer messages.

scope_advice.core: Normalize each existing exception-to-result boundary, including page errors before aggregation, Wembley calendar and outer processing. Preserve nonblank str(exception) verbatim and use the exception type name only for empty/whitespace text. Weather-only exceptions remain separate and should not mark availability failed.
scope_advice.desktop: Normalize the existing ScanWorker future exception result. No UI/render/lifecycle change is necessary because PR18 already handles a truthy error.
scope_advice.publisher: Both existing shard catches are the same defect: blank future failures count as fresh success and bypass prior-good fallback; blank delayed-retry failures count as recovered. Normalizing these strings is justified by offline majority/fallback/retry tests. The same main catch also protects the direct-result construction gate. No workflow, timeout, retry budget, classifier or publication-policy change is warranted.
scope_advice.retry_classification: Type-name fallbacks such as TimeoutError remain outside the existing confirmed-transport regex. Do not expand retry recognition as part of this fix.
